package com.platform.events.iam.principals;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public record PrincipalsSyncedData(
    String applicationCode,
    int created,
    int deactivated,
    List<String> syncedEmails,
    int updated
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static PrincipalsSyncedData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new PrincipalsSyncedData(
            (String) map.get("applicationCode"),
            (Integer) map.get("created"),
            (Integer) map.get("deactivated"),
            (List<String>) map.get("syncedEmails"),
            (Integer) map.get("updated")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("applicationCode", applicationCode);
        map.put("created", created);
        map.put("deactivated", deactivated);
        map.put("syncedEmails", syncedEmails);
        map.put("updated", updated);
        return map;
    }
}
